Maya: Heads up — new model partner (Orbis AI) wants to list weights on the marketplace and offer hosted serving. Need to confirm provenance and redistribution rights before we proceed. Putting a checklist here.
Ajay: Thanks, Maya. Do we have their upstream license and any CLA? We need export controls and confirmation about third-party data in training set.
Sam: Also need to decide hosting vs download SKU. For now assume both, but gate downloads until legal signs off.
Toni: From infra — quantized weights + on-prem packaging is doable but we may need KMS integration for private deployments.
Lia: Marketing note — timeline depends on embargo and joint PR. Flag if they want co-branding or speaker list.
PartnerBot: New partnership ticket created: ORBIS-2026-03. Assigned to Maya.
Maya: Draft checklist: 1) license scan, 2) provenance attestation, 3) export/regulatory review, 4) security/poisoning eval, 5) hosting vs download SKU definitions, 6) embargo dates, 7) announcement assets, 8) SI integration docs. Pasting template below.
Maya: ```
- license_file: (attach)
- provenance_statement: (signed PDF + SHA256)
- training_data_summary: (datasets + sources)
- export_controls: (countries restricted)
- security_eval_report: (fuzzing/poison tests)
- hosting_SKUs: hosted / dedicated / download-with-support
- embargo_window: YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD
- announcement_assets: logos, quotes, one-pager
```
Ajay: Add: indemnity clause and liability cap. Confirm training data rights (esp. scraped web or proprietary corpora). If custom license, we'll need a redline.
Toni: Ops question — do we require them to provide low-memory quantized checkpoints (4-bit) or will we generate? Partner claims they can provide Q4 params.
Sam: For marketplace listing, propose 3 SKUs: hosted, hosted-dedicated, download-with-support. Pricing model TBD; legal needs to sign on redistribution permissions.
Lia: Suggested embargo: 2-week quiet period post-contract, marketing begins prep once legal gives green light.
Maya: Owners: Ajay -> legal checklist, Toni -> packaging/quant, Sam -> pricing/SKUs, Lia -> announcement collateral. Partner requested tentative launch 2026-04-15.
Ajay: I'll run the license scan and export check by EOD Wednesday. If there are bespoke terms we'll request a contract redline.
Toni: I'll loop in eng-runtime for performance profiles and request a 2k-token latency run; will also validate hash verification flow.
Sam: Quick Q — do we allow partner to request download-only in some regions? That impacts geo-blocking and marketplace metadata.
Maya: Partner preference: hosted in NA/EU, download allowed in APAC for data residency. Ajay — export/reg restrictions could complicate APAC downloads.
Ajay: Confirmed. I'll flag any export-state or embargo issues for APAC markets.
Lia: :thumbsup: I'll draft a joint announcement checklist (logos, exec quotes, embargo, spokespeople) and send an asset request doc.
PartnerBot: Reminder: NDA expires in 10 days. Ping @Maya to request extension.
Maya: Also request provenance attestation: signed statement plus SHA256 of the tarball we will publish. We'll surface the hash in the model manifest.
Toni: We can verify hashes on ingest and publish a signed manifest to S3. We'll include provenance metadata in the model card.
Sam: Marketplace metadata needs: model card, recommended uses, known biases, tokenization details, sample inference costs.
Maya: Recap action items and deadlines:
- Ajay: complete license/export review by 2026-03-25
- Toni: perf profile + hash workflow by 2026-03-26
- Sam: SKU/pricing draft by 2026-03-27
- Lia: announcement assets request by 2026-03-24
- Partner: provide signed provenance + SHA256 and training data summary by 2026-03-22
Maya: Any blockers?
Ajay: Potential blocker: if training data includes proprietary downstream datasets, we may need stronger indemnity. I'll flag if so.
Toni: No infra blockers yet, but we need partner sample artifacts (checkpoint + small eval set).
Lia: Marketing needs spokespeople names asap.
Maya: Cool — I'll send the checklist to Orbis and set a follow-up call for Monday.
Sam: SGTM. I'll start a draft listing page template.
Maya: Thanks all. I'll post updates in this thread and tag when documents land.
